text:
maya: Quick proposal — break the Optimize toolkit into three launch slices: 1) Quick Wins (lightweight batching heuristics + cache configuration suggestions surfaced in Console), 2) Econ Advisor (per-route cost/latency recommendations and quantization suggestions for power users), 3) Eval Alerts (eval-triggered quality regression hooks with actionable context). For MVP we ship Quick Wins + a minimal Eval Alerts runner for pilot customers so we can validate value without heavy ops changes.

alex: +1. Can we turn acceptance criteria into measurable gates? e.g., 10% median token cost reduction on targeted workloads OR <5% p50 latency increase while achieving cost savings.

carla: Customer signals: pilot asks are mainly for per-endpoint guidance and a one-click suggestion export. Pilot candidates: two AI-native startups and one mid-market product team who already run our Dedicated tier. They want non-invasive changes (suggest, not auto-apply).

devon: Ops note: agree on suggest-only for MVP. We need telemetry before any auto actions: per-route token counts, batching frequency, prefix cache hit-rate, and quantization candidate flags. Also we must have a rollback story if heuristics cause regressions.

maya: Drafted MVP acceptance checklist: (a) Batching heuristics surfaced in Console with explanation and recommended config; (b) Telemetry pipeline shows >=1k affected requests/day across pilot tenants; (c) At least one pilot confirms >=8% cost reduction at parity latency or better; (d) Eval Alerts detect at least two regression signal types (semantic concordance drop + token-level surrogate) and surface root-cause context in the UI.

alex: For Eval Alerts, start with a small, configurable ruleset users can tune. Example rule DSL prototype: 

```json
{
  "signal": "eval_concordance",
  "threshold": 0.85,
  "window": "7d",
  "action": "notify:product,notify:ops"
}
```

That should be simple to wire to alerts and allow toggling channels.

carla: Ops + legal: alerting must be tenant-scoped, with PII redaction on any example contexts. Also need opt-in for sharing eval payloads externally (for support).

devon: Rough engineering estimate: Quick Wins backend + telemetry ~ 3 sprints (2 FE, 1 BE/instrumentation), Eval Alerts detection + plumbing ~ 2 sprints, UX & pilot flows ~ 1 sprint. Quantization recommendations require a model/bench infra spike and should be scoped to an experimental follow-up.

maya: Proposed timeline: Weeks 0–6 build telemetry + backend heuristics; Weeks 6–10 Console UX + pilot onboarding; Weeks 10–12 Eval Alerts pilot enabled. Gate to progress after week 10: telemetry must show stable signals and at least one pilot committed to test.

ops-bot: @maya Calendar: pilot sync with Ops + Sales scheduled for 2850003800 (invite sent). :calendar:

alex: Next immediate actions: maya to draft RFC with the acceptance checklist & pilot contacts, alex will mock UX wires and push a clickable prototype by EOD Friday.

maya: I'll produce the RFC and share here. Appreciate the quick feedback — starting the pilot contact outreach now. :raised_hands:
